Apply the general abelian-scheme statement with g=2 and n=ell^r for each r. Its proof does not use B11 markings or a chosen polarization. The good-model premise is supplied separately by finite spreading.

A finite etale algebra over a separably closed field is a product of copies of that field. Tag04GK lifts this decomposition and its maps uniquely. Naturality gives the torsion specialization and transition-map compatibility; the relative p-Frobenius identification remains the separate explicit source-target calculation in lines17–21.

Reuse the finite-equation argument for the same fixed abelian surface in this caller, without transferring the comparison family itself. Clear finitely many denominators in a projective model, multiplication, inverse and identity; remove the closed bad loci so properness and smoothness hold and the group identities persist. This yields only a qualitative finite set.

For each5-power order, splitting over the strict henselization says the generic torsion is defined over the maximal unramified extension. Thus inertia fixes every level and the inverse limit. The same finite-etale argument works for either original surface and uses no comparison Frobenius choice. At rational primes unramified in F, inertia in G_Q lies in G_F, where rho_5 is the actual Tate action. A direct summand is unramified. Excluding5, bad places and ramified primes proves finite ramification.

If geometrically reducible, irreducibility over Q makes the geometric factors one Galois orbit. Characteristic zero excludes repetition, so degree3 forces three conjugate linear factors. Every rational zero lies on all three; the rational line joining the two specified zeros remains in their intersection and realizes every rational input, contradiction.

Dominance preserves nonconstancy in function fields. Choose a real ball in the affine principal open. Rational density and continuity put its whole image in the closed set Z; connectedness makes that image constant. The numerator minus this constant times the denominator vanishes on a real open ball, hence identically, contradiction.

Write r_i=v(t-a_i). Since d(p)=0, v(dt)>=max r_i. If v(t)<0 all r_i agree and both forms have nonnegative valuation. Otherwise at most one r_i exceeds delta_p and 2max r_i-sum r_i>=-2delta_p. Multiplication by J^2 cancels this possible pole. Extension across codimension2 is a distinct retained input, not a conclusion of this valuation calculation.

Choose an etale scheme atlas of the regular Noetherian Deligne-Mumford maximal stack and trivialize the invertible square-dualizing line on affine open charts. Each connected regular chart is a normal domain. The generic bicanonical section is regular at horizontal height-one primes; the separate vertical valuation calculation proves it at vertical height-one primes. Apply Tag0AVB with the free rank-one module, which is reflexive, to obtain a unique regular section on each chart. The extensions agree on etale overlaps because they agree on the dense generic fibre and the line is locally free on a reduced flat atlas. Descent for sections gives the unique section on the stack. No coarse-model pullback or tame argument at bad primes is used.
